Asansol.x: Asansol is the headquarters of the Paschim Bardhaman district of West Bengal. It is at the centre of a major industrial area and the second largest urban agglomeration in the state.

Jhansi.x: Jhansi is a city in the Northern Bundelkhand region of Uttar Pradesh, India. It is very close to the central state of Madhya Pradesh and is overall more similar culturally to much of Madhya Pradesh than the rest of Uttar Pradesh. Jhansi's claim to fame is being the city where Rani Lakshmibai resisted against the British in the Great Rebellion of 1857.

sights.d: The fort of Jhansi was built in 1613, by Raja Bir Singh Judao (1606-27) of Orchha. This fort is built on a rocky hill and the city of Jhansi is around this fort.
sights.img: Inside the Rani Laxmibai's Jhansi Fort in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh 04.jpg

sights.d: Rani Mahal was built by Raghunath II of Newalkar family (1769-96). Rani Mahal is decorated with multicoloured paintings and art forms.
Baruasagar is around 24 km from Jhansi. It is a small town on the bank of Betwa river. It has a large lake which is called Barua sagar tal.
Chirgaon is 30 km from Jhansi, It is on the banks of Betwa river. It is on National Highway 25.
The Government Museum is in a very picturesque location in the heart of the city. The surrounding area has some beautiful parks.

Rewa.x: Rewa is a city in northeastern Madhya Pradesh, India, with a rich history and cultural significance. The city is home to the White Tiger Safari, a major tourist attraction. Additionally, The city hosts several historical sites, including the Rewa Fort and Govindgarh Palace, which reflect its architectural and cultural heritage.

Sattal.x: Sattal is a cluster of seven interconnected freshwater lakes in the Kumaon region of Uttarakhand, India. Nestled at an altitude of 1,370 m within dense oak and pine forests, it is a tranquil haven for birdwatchers, nature lovers, and those seeking a quiet alternative to the bustling hill stations of Nainital and Bhimtal.

Vellore.x: Vellore is a city of 505,000 people (2011) in Tamil Nadu, India. Visitors are drawn by its large 16th-century fort, which is known for its grand ramparts, wide moat and robust masonry. Apart from Fort tourism, Christian Medical College due to its esteemed position in the country, both as a medical college and a hospital, invites many students, medical practitioners, and patients from around the country.

Vijayawada.x: Vijayawada or Bezawada, the second-largest city in Andhra Pradesh, is the state's major commercial hub, on the upper banks of the Krishna River, opposite the state capital Amaravati. Famous for the Kanaka Durga Temple that attracts millions every year, Vijayawada is a part of the "Capital Region" (CR) of Andhra Pradesh, with almost all the amenities a traveller might need.
